spells.name: Call of the Void Stalker
spells.description: Use: Call upon two Void Stalkers to strike your target from two directions inflicting up to 1,844 Physical damage to all enemies in their paths. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Leeching Void
spells.description:
Use: Void energy pools at your feet for 10 sec, dealing 602 Shadow damage to targets standing within the area. You are healed for 300% of the damage dealt.
 (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Voidclaw
spells.description: Equip: Your autoattacks have a chance to deal 65 additional Shadow damage.

spells.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
spells.description: Use: Solve a puzzle, increasing your Mastery by 112 for 20 sec. (2 Min Cooldown)

193708.name: Platinum Star Band
193708.description: Tattukiaka in Iskaara would be interested in this sort of thing.

193719.name: Dragon Games Equipment
193719.description: Here at Algeth'ar Academy, we bring nothing but our A-game.

spells.name: Dragon Games Equipment
spells.description: Use: Empty out the Dragon Games kickballs onto the field. Running into them kicks them at your enemy target, inflicting 1,387 Physical damage. (2 Min Cooldown)

spells.name: Collect Argussian Crate
spells.description: Use: Add this Decor to your House Chest.

spells.name: Thalassian Phoenix Torque
spells.description:
Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to call upon the Phoenix Flames to envelop your target.

If your target is friendly, they are healed for 11,730 over 10 sec. If your target is an enemy, they instead suffer 7,821 Fire damage over 10 sec.

Every unique socketed gem color will strengthen the flames by 1%.

spells.name: Signet of Azerothian Blessings
spells.description:
Equip: Your spells and abilities may cause the signet to resonate with the Worldsoul, granting you a boon of 4 to all of your secondary stats for 15 sec.

Every unique socketed gem color strengthens their associated secondary stat granted by this boon by 1%.

241340.name: Magister's Alchemist Stone
241340.description: Can be used for transmutations in place of a Philosopher's Stone.

spells.name: Magister's Alchemist Stone
spells.description: Equip: When you heal or deal damage you have a chance to increase your Strength, Agility, or Intellect by 162 for 15 sec. Your highest stat is always chosen.

spells.name: Alchemist Stone
spells.description: Equip: Increases the effect that healing and mana potions have on the wearer by 40%.  This effect does not stack.

spells.name: Murder Row Fleet Feet
spells.description: Equip: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to increase your Avoidance by 80 for 10 sec.

spells.name: Knight-Commander's Palisade
spells.description:
Equip: The light protects. There is a chance when you are attacked to gain Palisade's Protection, granting an absorption shield for 1,192 damage lasting 6 sec. 

Should the shield be breached before it expires, the magic of the shield will erupt with Palisade's Penance, dealing 1,192 Holy damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Murder Row Fishhook
spells.description: Equip: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to bleed your target for 846 Physical damage over 10 sec.

spells.name: Hunt
spells.description:
Equip: Your spells and abilities have the chance to grant 168 secondary stats for 15 sec  based on the target creature's type.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Hunt.

spells.name: Blood
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have the chance to grant Farstrider's Guile, increasing your lowest secondary stat by 444 for 15 sec.

When an allied player dies, gain 232 of your highest secondary stat for 15 sec. This effect can only occur once every 5 min.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Blood.

spells.name: Rot
spells.description:
Equip: Afflict your target with Rotting Roots dealing 214 Nature Damage every 2 seconds for 6 sec. This effect stacks up to 10 times. New stacks do not refresh applied stacks.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Rot.

spells.name: Void
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have the chance to embolden you in Void Glass granting 123 Versatility over 15 sec. Multiple applications can overlap.

This effect is augmented by Darkmoon Sigil: Void.

249275.name: Bulwark of Noble Resolve
249275.description: "The only nobility is the destruction." - Imperator Averzian

spells.name: Gloom-Spattered Dreadscale
spells.description:
Use: Unleash a burst of hungering Gloom, dealing 3,489 Shadow damage split between nearby enemies and absorbing up to 50% of incoming damage until an equal amount of damage has been prevented.

Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%. (2 Min Cooldown)

spells.name: Heart of Ancient Hunger
spells.description: Equip: Your attacks have a chance to increase your Critical Strike by 83 and size, diminishing over 12 sec.

249343.name: Gaze of the Alnseer
249343.description: There are some places the faithful dare not look.

spells.name: Gaze of the Alnseer
spells.description: Equip: Your damage and healing has a chance to grant you Alnsight for 12 sec. While active, casting spells and abilities manifests unstable Alnscorned and consumes their essence to grant you 2 Intellect for 12 sec. Multiple applications may overlap.

249344.name: Light Company Guidon
249344.description: Forward, the Vanguard of the Light!

spells.name: Light Company Guidon
spells.description: Equip: You are a volunteer of the Vanguard of the Light.

spells.name: Charge!
spells.description: Use: Lead the charge to gain 74 Haste for 15 sec. All Vanguard of the Light volunteers within 40 yards also gain 18 Speed for 6 sec. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Riftbloom
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set chest item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Hungering Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set hand item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Fanatical Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set head item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Corrupted Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set leg item appropriate for your class.

spells.name: Unraveled Nullcore
spells.description: Use: Synthesize a soulbound set shoulder item appropriate for your class.

249367.name: Chiming Void Curio
249367.description: Find Kirana near the entrance to the March on Quel'Danas to trade this for powerful class set armor.

spells.name: Eternal Voidsong Chain
spells.description: Equip: Dealing Shadow damage has a chance to unleash a Voidstalker Sting, dealing 103 Shadow damage to your target over 10 sec. If reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the next Sting.

249805.name: Undreamt God's Oozing Vestige
249805.description: The ooze never seems to stop.

spells.name: Undreamt God's Oozing Vestige
spells.description:
Equip: You have a high chance to spatter your target with volatile phlegm, dealing 4 Nature damage per sec and stacking up to 5 times.

Upon 5 stacks or the enemy's demise, the phlegm violently consumes itself to deal 371 Nature damage split between nearby enemies. Damage increased by 30% per additional enemy, up to 150%.

spells.name: Radiant Plume
spells.description: Equip: The Plume's radiance grants you 30 Mastery, waning over 60 sec before reigniting to full incandescence. The Plume's power also regenerates while out of combat.

spells.name: Umbral Plume
spells.description: Use: While out of combat, invoke the Plume's dual nature to transform it into an Umbral Plume. (5 Min Cooldown)

spells.name: The Eternal Egg
spells.description: Equip: Your abilities have a chance to grant you a protective shell, absorbing up to 25% of incoming damage for 6 sec or until 1,197 damage has been prevented. If the shell expires without breaking, gain 41 Haste for 12 sec.

249915.name: Extinction Guards
249915.description: Someone has to be the last one standing.

spells.name: Eye of Midnight
spells.description: Equip: Taking Shadow damage greater than 15% of your maximum health grants you a barrier absorbing up to 240 damage and increasing your Avoidance by 10 while it holds. This effect may occur every 30 sec.

spells.name: Latch's Crooked Hook
spells.description: Use: Hurl a massive hook toward your target, cleaving through enemies in its path and dealing 577 Physical damage to each. When the hook crashes into the target, it inflicts 385 Physical damage split among enemies within 7 yards. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Kroluk's Warbanner
spells.description: Equip: Your melee attacks have a chance to summon an elite Axethrower who hurls an axe at your target, inflicting 1,498 Physical damage.

spells.name: Mark of Light
spells.description: Equip: Your attacks have a chance to unleash a Radiant Strike at your target, dealing 128 Holy damage split among nearby enemies.

spells.name: Jelly Replicator
spells.description:
Equip: Taking damage has a chance to form a jelly shield for 10 sec, absorbing 40% of incoming damage, up to 774.


If your health falls below 35%, the jelly instinctively thickens around you for 5 sec, absorbing up to 335 damage. This effect can only activate once every 1 min.

spells.name: Heart of Wind
spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to awaken the Heart of Wind, surrounding you with strong gales that increase your Haste by 22 for 10 sec.

250258.name: Vessel of Tortured Souls
250258.description: Don't tap the glass. They don't like that.

spells.name: Vessel of Souls
spells.description: Equip: Your spells and abilities have a chance to awaken a soul within the vessel. Each soul you collect increases your Intellect by 3 for 1 min.

spells.name: Voidstone Barrier
spells.description:
On Use: Activate the array and generate a Voidstone Barrier, absorbing 71,596 damage for the next 10 sec.

The barrier is further empowered by 1% per unique gem color you have socketed.

251161.name: Shroud of the Soulhunter
251161.description: A relic of the twisted rituals secret to the Vilebranch.

251169.name: Footwraps of Ill-Fate
251169.description: The Vilebranch walk a perilous path between life and death.

spells.name: Loa Worshiper's Band
spells.description:
Equip: Your damaging spells and abilities have a chance to charge the band, calling forth the avatar of a Loa to assist you in combat.

Each unique socketed gem color in your gear allows for different Loa to be summoned. These effects range from dealing damage to your foes or granting you temporary power.

spells.name: Solar Core Igniter
spells.description: Use: Ignite the Solar Core within you for 15 sec, forming a radiant shield that absorbs 50% of incoming damage, up to 827. Gain up to 23 Versatility for 10 sec if the shield expires, based on its remaining power. (1 Min 30 Sec Cooldown)

spells.name: Solarflare Prism
spells.description: Equip: Your damaging abilities have a chance to unleash the prism's radiant light, increasing your Critical Strike by 13 for 10 sec, further increased by 1 for every 1% of the target's missing health, up to a maximum of 16.

spells.name: Rotting Globule
spells.description:
Use: Cover yourself in four fetid pustules, absorbing 767 damage for 15 sec. Each time the shield loses 25% of its value, a pustule erupts, dealing 19  Plague damage split among nearby enemies.

If all pustules erupt, the final burst deals 11 additional Plague damage. (2 Min Cooldown)

effects.displayString: Set: Gain 35 Haste while above 80% health.
Set: Gain 35 Critical Strike while above 80% health.
Set: Your harmful spells and abilities have a chance to unleash a Twilight Barrage at your target.
Set: Mortal Strike and Cleave damage increased by 5%. Colossus Smash increases damage taken by an additional 5%.
Set: Damaging a target affected by Colossus Smash with Mortal Strike or Cleave that hits 3 or more targets extends Colossus Smash's effect on them by 1.0 sec.
